1. (Currently amended) An apparatus for aligning document actions specified in a documented procedure with demonstrated user actions, comprising: an alignment device for computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric, wherein said alignment device comprises a processor configured to execute instructions stored in a non-transitory computer-readable medium to perform the alignment computation, and wherein the alignment device is structurally and functionally integrated with computer hardware such that the alignment computation produces a functional change in the operation of the apparatus.

2. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein said alignment device identifies a current step in the documented procedure based on the alignment, and wherein the identification of the current step causes a functional change in the display or operation of the apparatus.

3. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 2, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and said alignment device provides an identification of the current step to the user interface for use in highlighting the current step on the user interface, wherein the highlighting comprises a visual modification of the user interface that is dependent on the computed alignment.

4. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 2, further comprising a user interface, in signal communication with said alignment device, for displaying the documented procedure, and wherein said alignment device outputs an identification of the current step to the user interface, and said user interface highlights the current step based on the identification, wherein the highlighting is a functional output that modifies the visual presentation of the user interface.

5. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein said alignment device identifies a next step in the documented procedure based on the alignment, and wherein the identification of the next step causes a functional change in the display or operation of the apparatus.

6. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 5, wherein the documented procedure is displayed on a user interface, and said alignment device provides an identification of the next step to the user interface for use in highlighting the next step on the user interface, wherein the highlighting comprises a visual modification of the user interface that is dependent on the computed alignment.

7. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 5, further comprising a user interface, in signal communication with said alignment device, for displaying the documented procedure, and wherein said alignment device outputs an identification of the next step to the user interface, and said user interface highlights the next step based on the identification, wherein the highlighting is a functional output that modifies the visual presentation of the user interface.

8. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the at least one similarity metric is based on a similarity of an action type involved in both a demonstrated user action and a document action, and wherein said alignment device computes the similarity metric by comparing structural characteristics of the demonstrated user action with structural characteristics of the document action to produce a quantitative measure that is used to determine the alignment.

9. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the demonstrated user actions are performed with respect to a user interface, and the at least one similarity metric is based on common strings in the user interface and the documented procedure, and wherein the alignment device compares the common strings to produce a functional determination of alignment.

11. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein said alignment device computes the alignment further based on previous user experiences with respect to performing the documented procedure, and wherein the previous user experiences are stored in a data structure that is accessed by the alignment device to modify the alignment computation.

12. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the documented procedure has a plurality of steps specified therein, and the apparatus further comprises a document action extractor for extracting at least some of the plurality of steps, wherein the document action extractor comprises a processor configured to execute instructions stored in a non-transitory computer-readable medium to perform the extraction.

13. (Currently amended) An apparatus for guiding user actions with respect to a documented procedure displayed on a user interface, the documented procedure having a plurality of steps specified therein, the apparatus comprising: an alignment device for computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric, wherein said alignment device comprises a processor configured to execute instructions stored in a non-transitory computer-readable medium to perform the alignment computation; a highlighting device, connected in signal communication with said alignment device, for visually highlighting on the user interface at least a portion of a step in the documented procedure based on the alignment computed by said alignment device; and a scrolling device, connected in signal communication with said alignment device, for automatically scrolling through each of the plurality of steps of the documented procedure on the user interface based on the alignment computed by said alignment device, wherein the highlighting and scrolling devices produce functional changes in the operation and display of the user interface.

14. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 13, wherein the alignment device, highlighting device, and scrolling device are structurally and functionally integrated with computer hardware and software components such that the computed alignment produces a functional change in the apparatus.

16. (Currently amended) The apparatus of claim 13, wherein said alignment device computes the alignment further based on previous user experiences with respect to performing the documented procedure, and wherein the previous user experiences are stored in a data structure that is accessed by the alignment device to modify the alignment computation.

17. (Currently amended) A method for aligning document actions specified in a documented procedure with demonstrated user actions, comprising the steps of: computing an alignment between the document actions and the demonstrated user actions based on at least one similarity metric, wherein the computing step is performed by a processor executing instructions stored in a non-transitory computer-readable medium, and wherein the computed alignment is used to produce a functional change in the operation of a computer system.

18. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17, further comprising the step of identifying a current step in the documented procedure based on the alignment, wherein the identification is used to produce a functional change in the display or operation of a computer system.

20. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17, further comprising the step of identifying a next step in the documented procedure based on the alignment, wherein the identification is used to produce a functional change in the display or operation of a computer system.

(Currently amended) The method of claim 17, wherein the documented procedure has a plurality of steps specified therein, and the method further comprises the step of extracting at least some of the plurality of steps from the documented procedure, wherein the extracting step is performed by a processor executing instructions stored in a non-transitory computer-readable medium.

27.
